interestingFact: India is home to the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
The Great Wall of China is one of the most famous man-made structures in the world.
The United States is home to Yellowstone, widely considered the world's first national park.
Indonesia is the world's largest archipelago, made up of thousands of islands.
Pakistan is home to K2, the second-highest mountain in the world.
Nigeria is often called the Giant of Africa because of its large population and economy.
Brazil contains most of the Amazon rainforest, the largest tropical rainforest on Earth.
Bangladesh is home to the Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove forest.
Russia is the largest country in the world by land area.
Japan is known for its Shinkansen bullet trains and its rich technological innovation.
Germany is known for its engineering excellence and its role in the European Union.
Iran is home to the ancient city of Persepolis, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
